Create beautiful presentations with AI

SlideCraft generates complete slide decks from a single prompt. Paste your notes, an article or a PDF and get a structured presentation with layouts, images and speaker notes in under a minute.

Features

  • Generate a full deck from one prompt or an uploaded document.
  • Export to PowerPoint and Google Slides with editable layouts.
  • Brand kits keep fonts and colors consistent across every deck.

Pricing

Start free with up to 3 presentations per month. The Pro plan costs $12 per month and unlocks unlimited decks and brand kits.

Teams use SlideCraft to prepare pitch decks, sales presentations and class lectures quickly.
